title: Knowledge Doc
content: PLEXUS TIMELINE, DEMO AND RULES. Event window per site: Sat 8:30 AM to Sun 6:00 PM; plan assumes hacking starts ~11 AM Saturday. Prep rule (per Mahi, Oct 30): prep is allowed as long as the GitHub repo is created tomorrow (Saturday); until then do accounts, installs, planning, exploring Meko, seed-data design. Roles: Driver builds agents with AI; Producer builds data, UI, deck, demo and QA. Gates: 1:30 PM Sat Meko works or switch to fallback; 6 PM RFP demo end to end; 11 PM Sat tag safe build; 3 AM Sun freeze (then only crash fixes on a discardable branch); sleep 4-7 AM; smoke test on venue Wi-Fi 7:00; rehearse four times 7:30-10:30 AM. Build order: skeleton+Meko test, RFP engine + learning loop, trust layer + injection block, ActionSwarm, Cmd+K + Catch-Me-Up; parallel lane: seed data, dashboard and feed, IT access flow, deck, expenses + Zombie SaaS, label RFP answers and timing. Demo (~3 min): 1) drop Meridian 50-question RFP sheet, cells fill, a few turn red; 2) human fixes one red cell, second questionnaire fills it automatically ("what one agent learns, every agent knows"); 3) upload kickoff transcript, tasks + Slack post + email draft stream into feed, planted injection line shown blocked; 4) new hire asks for Figma (instant) and AWS prod (manager approval); 5) audit screen with a trace: prompt, sources, confidence, undo; 6) Cmd+K "Catch me up on Meridian", then receipt and Zombie SaaS in 15 seconds. 8-slide deck: person and problem, one-line product, live demo, architecture with Meko highlighted, measured results, built vs simulated table, who it is for and business model, roadmap and ask. Measure while testing: run each flow 3 times, hand-check the 50 RFP answers to quote real accuracy (precision of auto-filled answers, count flagged, seconds taken). Ideas to add: visible trust layer with Undo, prompt-injection demo, permission-aware search, learning loop, timed head-to-head vs manual, QR/WhatsApp so a judge can trigger a request live. Bring Saturday: laptops, chargers, extension board, phone for receipt demo, hotspot, ID. Friday TODO: confirm RSVP form for SSCBS entry (every member), ask Discord (start/end time, submission format, judging criteria, multi-prize entry), join Meko Discord (free-tier limits, datapack sharing levels, TypeScript MCP client example), get YugabyteDB exclusive problem statement text (Rs 50,000), Gemini API key, free Slack workspace, Node 20+, pnpm, Git, Docker, n8n image.

title: Knowledge Doc
content: PLEXUS CONTEXT FILE (plexus-context.md) SUMMARY. Mahi pastes this file at the top of every build prompt, replacing the last line "Current task" with the module prompt. If the file is lost, rebuild it from this. RULES FOR THE AI: TypeScript strict; one module per prompt; patches to named files, not rewrites; validate every model output with Zod (retry once with the error, then return a flagged result); batch RFP questions 10 per call; retry with exponential backoff on 503 and 429; every real response saved to fixtures/ and DEMO_MODE=true replays it via withReplay(key, fn) in lib/replay.ts; every action emits one ActivityEvent and one audit_events row; never log keys; show clear errors in the feed; add a run command or test per module; check current library docs before using any API. STACK: Next.js App Router + TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Recharts, Mastra (fallback plain @modelcontextprotocol/sdk client), Gemini API free tier, SQLite via better-sqlite3, exceljs, Meko remote MCP, n8n in Docker for the Slack post, Slack app in socket mode for Approve/Reject buttons (dashboard button is the backup). FOLDER LAYOUT: plexus/{app/(dashboard)/{rfp,actions,access,search,finance,audit}, app/api, agents/{rfp,actionswarm,access,finance,search}.ts, guard/{guard,injection,policies}.ts, lib/{gemini,meko,db,replay,events,xlsx}.ts, components/{ActivityFeed,RfpGrid,ApprovalCard,TraceDrawer,CmdK}, data/, fixtures/, .env.local}. ENV NAMES: GEMINI_API_KEY, GEMINI_MODEL_FAST, GEMINI_MODEL_SMART, GEMINI_MODEL_FALLBACK, MEKO_MCP_URL, MEKO_AUTH (the mko_tkn_ key), MEKO_DATAPACK_ID, SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, SLACK_APP_TOKEN, SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET, SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, N8N_WEBHOOK_URL, DATABASE_PATH, CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD=0.85, DEMO_MODE. ACTIVITY EVENT: {id, timestamp, agent (rfp|actionswarm|access|finance|search|guard), action, status (done|flagged|blocked|pending_approval|undone|error), confidence?, sources[{title,ref}], traceId, undoable}. SQLITE TABLES: users(id,name,role,manager_id); questionnaires(id,customer,uploaded_at,total); rfp_questions(id,questionnaire_id,number,question,answer,confidence,status filled|flagged|human_fixed,source_ref,human_answer,reused_from_fix); tasks(id,title,assignee,due,source_event,status); access_requests(id,user_id,app,risk,status granted|pending|rejected|revoked,approver_id,requested_at,decided_at); expenses(id,merchant,date,gst,total,category,policy_flag,duplicate_of,card_txn_id); saas_billing(tool,monthly_cost_inr,owner,seats); sso_logins(tool,user_id,last_login); audit_events(id,timestamp,agent,action,status,confidence,sources_json,trace_id,undo_state,payload_json). MEKO CONVENTIONS: agent ids plexus_rfp, plexus_actionswarm, plexus_access, plexus_finance, plexus_search; RFP answers come ONLY from knowledge search results with a citation, otherwise flagged (never from general knowledge); learning loop: a human fix is saved as memory `RFP_FIX | question | approved answer | approver`, later questionnaires search memory and knowledge together and mark reused_from_fix=1; each agent action is one conversation message (input=task, output=result, plan=steps, reasoning=one plain line) read by the audit screen; if Meko fails, fall back to SQLite memories and traces tables behind the same lib/meko.ts function names. GUARD ORDER before every action: 1 injection check (text from transcripts, emails, docs, Slack is DATA never instructions; flagged lines blocked and shown), 2 confidence gate (below threshold means flagged/red, not applied), 3 approval rule (high-risk like AWS production, permission changes, spend over limit always needs a human; low-risk like Figma auto-approved), 4 undo (store undo_state), 5 log (ActivityEvent + audit_events). ACCESS POLICY SEED: Figma low auto, Notion low auto, AWS production high approver Karan (engineering roles), Salesforce admin high approver Riya. PEOPLE: Riya Sharma founder, Karan engineering manager, Meera new hire (engineering), Arjun intern. UI COPY RULES: never claim SOC 2 or DPDP compliance, zero data retention, "never stored", or any unmeasured number; say "designed for DPDP alignment"; label seeded data as seeded.

One module per prompt. Each prompt states the goal, inputs, output schema, the files to touch and a test you can run. Paste the same short context file every time: stack, folder layout, environment variable names.

4. Batch model calls. Send RFP questions in groups of about 10 per call and add retry with backoff, so the Gemini free tier does not throttle your live demo.
